name: zclass_node_get_raycastable
description: zClass_Class::gwNodeGetRaycastable returns bit 4 of zClass node flags and preserves the null-node error behavior.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the zClass node flag accessor/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4481f0 validates the null-node guard and output of (flags >> 4) & 1.
The native smoke toggles the raycastable flag through the setter, reads it through the getter, and checks the null-node error return.
